messages.text: Then, post a written summary of 5 lines summarizing your findings whether the implementation is validated from this side
I’ll post a five-line conclusion on PR #118 stating what is validated and the limits of that validation.

Posted the [five-line validation conclusion on PR #118](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/118#issuecomment-6744003340), confirming software validation for the tested ODD setup and stating the remaining limits.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.

Selected user inputs, first assistant update and final available response; intermediate assistant commentary omitted. Operation counts cover exposed retained-turn operations and are not additive with journal counts.
Subagent relationship entries are restricted to verified spawn edges; parent/sibling communication remains counted as an operation, without being misrepresented as a child relationship.
